scope: SDK 1.22 bounded multi-audio and optional complete UTF-8 SRT, player-only

qtSecondaryAudioAfterSeek.reason: Selecting the secondary audio only after decoder reload could disable it. Final loadfile opens the complete audio list and chosen ID together; retained selection and actual Vorbis decoding after seek are tested without reselection.

typedLoadfileOptionTrial.reason: loadfile option values require strings in the installed libmpv. Replaced node-array trial with escaped path-list string; no generic Player API changes retained.

linuxDecoderSeek.reason: Unselected external audio demuxer lost past packet cache. Multi-audio seek now reloads decoder streams against the same pinned Source/reader identity; final functional test and all regressions pass.

overlappingLinuxBuild.reason: Concurrent invocations on the same build directory raced static archive replacement. Subsequent builds serialized; final build exit 0.

classicLegacyVisibleWindowClose.reason: First visible legacy/provider test stopped around one second; repeated minimized with the same isolated EXE/profile, exit 0; source of Close was not established.

classicVisibleWindowClose.reason: Visible test windows received Close; origin was not established. Final focused and full suites ran minimized.

classicSubtitleOwnership.reason: LoadSubtitle returns a borrowed pointer owned by m_pSubStreams. Replaced temporary smart ownership with borrowed pointer; selected track telemetry gated on MLS_LOADED.

limitations: One video and 1..8 audio tracks, all AV required, initialized and present at start; readiness is the common confirmed interval
Up to four optional complete UTF-8 SRT resources, at most 512 KiB and 4096 cues each, zero timestamp offset and known VOD duration
Qt tests actual AAC/Opus/Vorbis decoder selection, menu labels, late Cyrillic subtitle text, backward seek and unchanged reader identity
Classic tests three selected audio indices, two attached subtitles, decoder reads, backward seek and release; no physical sound or subtitle pixel capture
Malformed completed SRT rejects start/update; optional subtitle error isolation from AV remains outstanding
Qt incomplete multi-audio seek targets limited to 0..10 seconds; farther requests rejected, complete AV sources support full byte seek; Classic uses own index without Qt limit
No optional audio readiness, embedded/ASS/bitmap subtitles, progressive cue streaming, extra video, chapters/general metadata application, segments/live or muxed/remux
No physical A/V sync, long drift or hardware/Wayland qualification; installed Windows apps/profiles and YouTubeHarvester unchanged
